promise: By June, we will compile a roadmap to realize the new form of capitalism
description: In his January 2023 policy speech to the Diet, Kishida promised a concrete roadmap for his flagship 'new capitalism' (shin shihonshugi) policy by June 2023. The Cabinet approved the roughly 200-measure roadmap on June 16, 2023, covering wage growth, investment in people, and science/tech priorities, meeting the deadline he set.
evidence: Cabinet approved the 'New Form of Capitalism' roadmap on June 16, 2023
Roadmap included ~200 measures on wages, human capital investment, and innovation

review.note: Prime Minister's Office confirms June 16 council consideration of updated new-capitalism policy. Need January 23 exact commitment, cabinet decision and source for 'roughly 200 measures'; meeting alone is not proof of the specific promised roadmap.

promise: Microsoft was working toward closing its Activision Blizzard acquisition in fiscal 2023, subject to regulatory approvals.
description: Microsoft said in January 2023 that it was working toward an FY2023 close, subject to regulatory approvals. The acquisition closed October 13, 2023, after the June fiscal year-end.
evidence: January earnings transcript retains regulatory-approval condition.
Official October 13 employee announcement confirms completion.

promise: Twitter has a chance of becoming cash-flow positive in Q2 2023
description: On March 7, 2023, Musk said Twitter had a chance of positive cash flow the following quarter. In July he said cash flow remained negative, citing advertising weakness and debt.
evidence: Musk's July admission indicated the Q2 cash-flow expectation was missed.
